messages:
Maria: mini handoff — quick async standup. What I did: pushed routing-policy linter (rejects overlapping prefix rules), fixed auth header parse for `x-rw-auth` that dropped when there was whitespace, and ran a short smoke on staging. Observed a small 429 spike on long-tail keys after ~10k requests. Blockers: need a short canary rate bump (1.5x) to validate batching changes, and want a quick CR on PR #842. Today: will follow up with a tiny fix for handling `Bearer ` with weird casing and pair with SRE for the canary window. @Devin can you take a look at #842?

Devin: got it — will review after standup. Quick note: if we bump the rate limit flag we should gate by region so EU doesn't blow quota. I can add a region filter to the rollout.

Samir: saw the 429s in the same window, looks like KV-cache misses are higher for heavy prefix overlap. The linter change should help long term. Short term we can reduce batch size from 64->48 for the offending worker pool.

Kira: added a comment on #842 about adding unit tests for the header parser. lgtm on the linter rule, but please add a small changelog entry so infra knows about behavior change. :memo:

Maria: thanks — adding changelog now. For the canary timing, thinking 30m quiet window, 10m monitor then ramp if stable. ops pinged.

ops-bot: deploy-trigger: canary-rollout/gateway-v1.3.7 initiated by @Maria at 2026-03-15T09:10:23Z — instances: 6 -> 9, policy: rate-bump=1.5x (region=us-east).

Devin: acknowledged. I'll add the region gating and post the PR for ops to use the flag. Will also run the small perf test script: `scripts/perf_burst.sh --workers 48 --duration 5m`.

Samir: if canary shows errors > 1% we should auto-fallback. Can you add the fallback hook to the rollout? I can wire a quick alert that watches 5xx and 429s.

Maria: yep — adding fallback hook now and will push a follow-up commit.

Kira: FYI I've scheduled a 15m sync at 11:30am to pair on the header unit tests and the changelog wording.

Devin: reviewing #842 now, should be done in ~45m.

ops-bot: canary-rollout/gateway-v1.3.7 status: running (10m) — errors=0.4% 429s increased +0.7% vs baseline, no auto-fallback triggered.

Maria: sweet. thanks everyone — will post post-canary notes in this thread. :thumbsup:
